players.summary: Signed up as ada_quill_r4 and built Ada Quill, a Scholar (Professor), in the creator. It took path, profile with portrait upload (hymn_sheet.jpg), action ratings and drives, then gear. I joined gullhaven-r4 with the Homemade Apple handwriting. The hub then showed the Case Ledger as "Awaiting approval", with a toast saying the hub will say when the Lightkeeper answers. I introduced Ada at the table. I logged F005 (praise: the waiting state is clear), F006 (the join dialog appears 2-3 seconds late, with no feedback) and F007 (the Portrait control is a hidden file input for screen readers). About a minute later the Lightkeeper had not yet approved, so I could not test whether the hub notices approval by itself; that is for next turn. I made one typo in the Style field (a stray CJK word) and corrected it. No reloads, and no errors beyond "no new problems". Memory file updated.
